_meta.breaks: Different instrument and cohort definition than the paired 19–35-month series (birth-year cohort at exactly 24 months vs. survey-year snapshot of children 19–35 months); the two are a paired comparison, not a continuous series.
_meta.name: DTaP ≥4 doses by 24 months
_meta.note: CDC NIS-Child share receiving at least four DTaP doses by age 24 months. Cohort is the birth year (children by age 24 months, by birth year). This is a paired comparison with the survey-year 19–35-month series, not a continuation of it.
